question: Can an adaptive repair loop that detects one-hop failures and generates corrective examples be effectively implemented and improve the reliability of base facts in a language model-based KGQA system?
description: The idea includes an adaptive repair loop to iteratively refine the model by correcting one-hop failures. It is uncertain whether such a loop can be designed to generate meaningful corrective examples without causing instability or overfitting.
rationale: While repair loops have been used in other domains (e.g., program repair), their application to KGQA fact verification is not well-established in the retrieved literature.
